standard: Ceramic matrix composite records for stationary hot parts; values are measured where the source measured them and projected where it gives only constituents

SIC-SIC-N24A.name: N24A melt-infiltrated SiC/SiC, 2-D five-harness iBN-Sylramic fibre, CVI BN and SiC, MI SiC matrix
sources: NASA/TM-2009-215806, Mital, Bednarcyk, Arnold and Lang, Modeling of Melt-Infiltrated SiC/SiC Composite Properties, Oct 2009 (ntrs.nasa.gov/citations/20090041359): Table III (room temperature) and Table IV (1204 C) experiment columns; Table I constituent properties

Morscher and Pujar, Design Guidelines for In-Plane Mechanical Properties of SiC Fiber-Reinforced Melt-Infiltrated SiC Composites (ntrs.nasa.gov/citations/20080047739): design stress limit at the onset of matrix cracking (about 95 MPa minimatrix stress) and a design total strain limit of about 0.3% for creep up to 1200-1315 C
SIC-SIC-N24A.rho_basis: PROJECTED from Table I constituent densities (fibre 3.2, BN 1.4, CVI SiC 3.2, MI SiC 2.9 g/cm3); the report gives no composite density
